translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day guichou, the Administrator of Huainan Yuan Jing, having committed a crime, was executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guichou, Administrator of Huainan Yuan Jing was executed in the marketplace for a crime.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，以侍中孔靈符為郢州刺史。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day bingwu, the Palace Attendant Kong Lingfu was made Inspector of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingwu, Palace Attendant Kong Lingfu was made Inspector of Ying.

sentences.zh: 大明元年春正月辛亥朔，改元，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the first day of the first month of spring in the first year of Daming, xinhai, the era name was changed and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the first month of Daming, xinhai, the era name was changed and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 賜高年孤疾粟帛各有差。

translations.literal: The aged, the orphaned, and the sick were each granted grain and silk in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: The aged, orphans, and sick each received grain and silk in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 庚午，護軍將軍劉延孫遷職，右衞將軍湘東王彧為中護軍。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, the General Who Protects the Army Liu Yansun was transferred to another post; the General of the Right Guard Prince of Xiangdong Yu was made General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu General Who Protects the Army Liu Yansun was reassigned; General of the Right Guard Prince of Xiangdong Yu was made General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 京邑雨水，辛未，遣使檢行，賜以樵米。

translations.literal: Rain flooded the capital region; on the day xinwei, envoys were dispatched to inspect the damage and firewood and grain were granted.
translations.idiomatic: The capital region was flooded by rain; on xinwei envoys were sent to inspect and grants of firewood and grain were made.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，復親民職公田。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jihai, the people's public fields for officials' salaries were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jihai, the people's public fields for officials' salaries were restored.

sentences.zh: 索虜寇兗州。

translations.literal: The Rong enemy raided Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: The northern enemy raided Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌，制大臣加班劍者，不得入宮城門。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day renxu, it was ordained that great ministers granted the added ceremonial swords might not enter the palace city gates.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renxu, it was ordained that great ministers with added ceremonial swords might not enter the palace gates.

sentences.zh: 梁州獠求內屬，立懷漢郡。

translations.literal: The Liao of Liang sought to submit and be incorporated; the commandery of Huaihan was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao of Liang sought incorporation; the commandery of Huaihan was established.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，京邑疾疫，丙申，遣使按行，賜給醫藥。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, plague struck the capital region; on the day bingshen, envoys were dispatched to inspect and medicine was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer plague struck the capital; on bingshen envoys were sent to inspect and medicine was distributed.

sentences.zh: 死而無收斂者，官為斂埋。

translations.literal: Those who died without anyone to bury them were buried at official expense.
translations.idiomatic: Those who died with no one to bury them were buried by the state.

sentences.zh: 庚子，省湘州宋建郡并臨賀。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, the commandery of Songjian in Xiang Province was abolished and merged into Linhe.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the commandery of Songjian in Xiang Province was abolished and merged into Linhe.

sentences.zh: 五月，吳興、義興大水，民饑。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, great floods struck Wuxing and Yixing and the people suffered famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Wuxing and Yixing suffered great floods and the people went hungry.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，遣使開倉賑卹。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, envoys were dispatched to open the granaries for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao envoys were sent to open the granaries for relief.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，於華林園聽訟。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, cases were heard at the Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the emperor heard cases at the Hualin Garden.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以左衞將軍沈曇慶為徐州刺史，輔國將軍梁瑾葱為河州刺史、宕昌王。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the General of the Left Guard Shen Tanqing was made Inspector of Xu; the General Who Assists the State Liang Jincong was made Inspector of He and King of Dangchang.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai General of the Left Guard Shen Tanqing was made Inspector of Xu, and General Who Assists the State Liang Jincong was made Inspector of He and King of Dangchang.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，以前太子步兵校尉劉祗子歆繼南豐王朗。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jimao, the former Crown Prince's Colonel of Footsoldiers Liu Zhi's son Xin succeeded Prince of Nanfeng Lang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jimao, former Crown Prince's Colonel of Footsoldiers Liu Zhi's son Xin succeeded Prince of Nanfeng Lang.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以長水校尉山陽王休祐為東揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, the Colonel of the Long River Prince of Shanyang Xiuyou was made Inspector of Eastern Yang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Colonel of the Long River Prince of Shanyang Xiuyou was made Inspector of Eastern Yang.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，休祐改為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Xiuyou was changed to Inspector of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Xiuyou was made Inspector of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 以丹陽尹顏竣為東揚州刺史。

translations.literal: The Administrator of Danyang Yan Jun was made Inspector of Eastern Yang.
translations.idiomatic: Administrator of Danyang Yan Jun was made Inspector of Eastern Yang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，土斷雍州諸僑郡縣。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day xinwei, the migrant commanderies and counties of Yong Province were subjected to land registration.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinwei, migrant commanderies and counties in Yong were subjected to land registration.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，於兗州立陽平郡。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day wuxu, the commandery of Yangping was established in Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuxu, the commandery of Yangping was established in Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，於華林園聽訟。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, cases were heard at the Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the emperor heard cases at the Hualin Garden.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，司空、南徐州刺史竟陵王誕改為南兗州刺史，太子詹事劉延孫為鎮軍將軍、南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Prince of Jingling Dan, Minister of Works and Inspector of Southern Xu, was changed to Inspector of Southern Yan; the Steward of the Eastern Palace Liu Yansun was made General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Southern Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Minister of Works and Inspector of Southern Xu Prince of Jingling Dan was made Inspector of Southern Yan, and Steward of the Eastern Palace Liu Yansun was made General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Southern Xu.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，詔曰：「旒纊之道，有孚於結繩，日昃之勤，已切於姬后。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day bingshen, an edict was issued: The way of the skirted cap and covered face finds sincerity even in the age of knotted cords; the diligence of the sun at its zenith has long matched that of the consort of King Wen.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingshen, an edict declared: The way of the veiled ruler showed faith even in the age of knotted cords; the toil of ruling past noon long since equaled that of King Wen's queen.

sentences.zh: 況世弊教淺，歲月澆季。

translations.literal: How much more when the age is decadent, instruction shallow, and the years a season of decline.
translations.idiomatic: How much more when the age is corrupt, teaching shallow, and the years a season of decline.

sentences.zh: 朕雖勠力宇內，未明求衣，而識狹前王，務廣昔代，永言菲德，其愧良深。

translations.literal: Though I exert my strength within the realm and have not yet risen at dawn to seek good counsel, my understanding is narrower than that of former kings and my aims broader than those of past ages; ever speaking of my meager virtue, the shame is truly deep.
translations.idiomatic: Though I labor within the realm and have not yet risen at dawn to rule, my understanding falls short of former kings while my aims exceed those of past ages; ever mindful of my slight virtue, my shame runs deep.

sentences.zh: 朝咨野怨，自達者寡，惠民利公，所昧實眾。

translations.literal: In court one consults, in the wilds there is resentment, yet few make themselves heard; to benefit the people and serve the public good is what most do not understand.
translations.idiomatic: Court consultation and popular grievance abound, yet few are heard; how to benefit the people and serve the public good is what most do not grasp.

sentences.zh: 自今百辟庶尹，下民賤隸，有懷誠抱志，擁鬱衡閭，失理負謗，未聞朝聽者，皆聽躬自申奏，小大以聞。

translations.literal: From this day forward, among the hundred ministers and myriad officials, down to the humblest bondservants, all who harbor sincere intent, who are pent up at their doorways, who have suffered injustice and borne slander yet have not been heard at court may present petitions in person, great and small alike being reported.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, from the hundred ministers down to the humblest bondservants, all who harbor sincere intent, who are pent up at home, who have suffered injustice or borne slander without a hearing at court may petition in person, reporting matters great and small.

sentences.zh: 朕因聽政之日，親對覽焉。

translations.literal: On the days when I hear cases in person, I shall review them myself.」
translations.idiomatic: On the days when I hear cases, I shall review them myself.」

sentences.zh: 」甲辰，以百濟王餘慶為鎮東大將軍。

translations.literal: 」On the day jiachen, the King of Baekje Yu Qing was made Grand General Who Pacifies the East.
translations.idiomatic: 」On jiachen the King of Baekje Yu Qing was made Grand General Who Pacifies the East.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，順陽王休範改封桂陽王。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day dinghai, Prince of Shunyang Xiufan was enfeoffed anew as Prince of Guiyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dinghai, Prince of Shunyang Xiufan was enfeoffed anew as Prince of Guiyang.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，於華林園聽訟。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, cases were heard at the Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the emperor heard cases at the Hualin Garden.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月辛亥，車駕祀南郊。

translations.literal: In the second year, in the first month of spring, on the day xinhai, the imperial carriage sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on xinhai in the first month of spring, the emperor sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔曰：「去歲東土多經水災。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, an edict was issued: Last year the eastern lands suffered many floods.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi an edict declared: Last year the eastern lands suffered many floods.

sentences.zh: 春務已及，宜加優課。

translations.literal: Spring tasks are already due; favorable tax assessments should be increased.
translations.idiomatic: Spring work is already due; tax assessments should be eased.

sentences.zh: 糧種所須，以時貸給。

translations.literal: Seed grain required should be lent out in season.」
translations.idiomatic: Required seed grain should be lent out in season.」

sentences.zh: 」丙辰，復郡縣田秩，并九親祿俸。

translations.literal: 」On the day bingchen, the field stipends of commanderies and counties were restored, together with the salaries of the nine degrees of kin.
translations.idiomatic: 」On bingchen the field stipends of commanderies and counties were restored, together with salaries for the nine degrees of kin.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔曰：「先帝靈命初興，龍飛西楚，歲紀浸遠，感往纏心。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, an edict was issued: When the late emperor's numinous mandate first arose, he soared like a dragon in western Chu; the years have grown distant and remembrance of the past binds the heart.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu an edict declared: When the late emperor's mandate first arose he rose like a dragon in western Chu; the years have grown distant and memory of the past binds the heart.

sentences.zh: 奉迎文武，情深常隸，思弘殊澤，以申永懷。

translations.literal: Those civil and military men who welcomed him bore constant affection; thinking to extend exceptional grace, I thereby express enduring remembrance.
translations.idiomatic: The civil and military men who welcomed him bore deep and constant affection; wishing to extend exceptional grace, I thereby express enduring remembrance.

sentences.zh: 吏身可賜爵一級，軍戶免為平民。」

translations.literal: Household registers of clerks may each be granted one rank of nobility; military households are freed to commoner status.」
translations.idiomatic: Clerks on the household registers may each receive one rank of nobility; military households are freed to commoner status.」

sentences.zh: 二月丙子，詔曰：「政道未著，俗弊尚深，豪侈兼并，貧弱困窘，存闕衣裳，沒無斂槥，朕甚傷之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day bingzi, an edict was issued: The way of government is not yet manifest and popular abuses run deep; the powerful grow extravagant and absorb the weak, the poor are pressed into distress; the living lack clothing and the dead lack coffins—I am deeply grieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingzi, an edict declared: Government is not yet settled and popular abuses run deep; the powerful grow extravagant while the poor are crushed; the living lack clothes and the dead lack coffins—I am deeply grieved.

sentences.zh: 其明敕守宰，勤加存卹。

translations.literal: Let the prefects and magistrates be clearly instructed to work diligently at relief and care.
translations.idiomatic: Let prefects and magistrates be clearly instructed to work diligently at relief and care.

sentences.zh: 賻贈之科，速為條品。

translations.literal: The regulations for funeral gifts should quickly be set forth in articles.」
translations.idiomatic: Regulations for funeral gifts should quickly be drawn up in articles.」

sentences.zh: 」乙酉，以金紫光祿大夫褚湛之為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: 」On the day yiyou, the Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the Golden Seal Chu Zhanzhi was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: 」On yiyou Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the Golden Seal Chu Zhanzhi was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，中書監、尚書令、衞將軍建平王宏以本號開府儀同三司，中書監如故。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the Director of the Secretariat, Director of the Masters of Writing, and General of the Guard Prince of Pingcheng Hong was given credentials equal to an open office with the Three Excellencies, his directorship of the Secretariat remaining unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Director of the Secretariat, Director of the Masters of Writing, and General of the Guard Prince of Pingcheng Hong received credentials equal to an open office with the Three Excellencies, retaining the Secretariat directorship.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，驃騎將軍柳元景以本號開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, the Grand General Who Pacifies the Cavalry Liu Yuanjing was given credentials equal to an open office with the Three Excellencies under his former title.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Grand General Who Pacifies the Cavalry Liu Yuanjing received credentials equal to an open office with the Three Excellencies under his former title.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，散騎常侍義陽王昶為中軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Prince of Yiyang Chang was made General of the Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Prince of Yiyang Chang was made General of the Central Army.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，中書監、尚書令、衞將軍建平王宏薨。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day dingwei, the Director of the Secretariat, Director of the Masters of Writing, and General of the Guard Prince of Pingcheng Hong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingwei, Director of the Secretariat, Director of the Masters of Writing, and General of the Guard Prince of Pingcheng Hong died.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以田農要月，太官停殺牛。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, because it was a critical month for farming, the Imperial Kitchen ceased slaughtering cattle.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, as it was a critical month for farming, the Imperial Kitchen ceased slaughtering cattle.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上於華林園聽訟。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the emperor heard cases at the Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the emperor heard cases at the Hualin Garden.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以寧朔將軍劉季之為司州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, the General Who Pacifies the North Liu Jizhi was made Inspector of Si.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou General Who Pacifies the North Liu Jizhi was made Inspector of Si.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申，立皇子子綏為安陸王。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day jiashen, the imperial son Zisui was installed as Prince of Anlu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiashen, the imperial son Zisui was made Prince of Anlu.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以海陵王休茂為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Prince of Hailing Xiumao was made Inspector of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Prince of Hailing Xiumao was made Inspector of Yong.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，地震。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申，復西陽郡。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day wushen, the commandery of Xiyang was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wushen, the commandery of Xiyang was restored.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅，增置吏部尚書一人，省五兵尚書。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day wuyin, one additional Master of the Ministry of Personnel was appointed and the Master of the Five Arms was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuyin, one additional Master of the Ministry of Personnel was appointed and the Master of the Five Arms was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，左光祿大夫何尚之加開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, the Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness He Shangzhi was given credentials equal to an open office with the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness He Shangzhi received credentials equal to an open office with the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以金紫光祿大夫羊玄保為右光祿大夫。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, the Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the Golden Seal Yang Xuanbao was made Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the Golden Seal Yang Xuanbao was made Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔曰：「往因師旅，多有逋亡。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, an edict was issued: In the past, because of military campaigns, many fled and went into hiding.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen an edict declared: In the past, because of military campaigns, many fled and went into hiding.

sentences.zh: 或連山染逆，懼致軍憲；

translations.literal: Some, dwelling in remote hills, had been touched by rebellion and feared military punishment;
translations.idiomatic: Some, dwelling in remote hills, had been touched by rebellion and feared military punishment;

sentences.zh: 或辭役憚勞，苟免刑罰。

translations.literal: some, shirking corvée and dreading toil, sought only to escape punishment.
translations.idiomatic: some shirked corvée and dreaded toil, seeking only to escape punishment.

sentences.zh: 雖約法從簡，務思弘宥，恩令驟下，而逃伏猶多。

translations.literal: Though the law was kept simple and broad mercy was intended, grace edicts were issued in rapid succession, yet those in hiding remained numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Though the law was kept simple and broad mercy was intended, grace edicts followed one after another, yet fugitives remained numerous.

sentences.zh: 豈習愚為性，忸惡難反；

translations.literal: Was it that stupidity had become their nature and shame at evil made return difficult;
translations.idiomatic: Was it that stupidity had become their nature and shame at evil made return difficult;

sentences.zh: 將在所長吏，宣導乖方。

translations.literal: or was it that the local chief officials had guided and proclaimed the policy awry.
translations.idiomatic: or was it that local chiefs had guided and proclaimed the policy awry.

sentences.zh: 可普加寬申，咸與更始。」

translations.literal: Let grace be extended broadly and all be granted a new beginning.」
translations.idiomatic: Let grace be extended broadly and all be granted a new beginning.」

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，彭城民高闍等謀反伏誅。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jiachen, Gao Ge of Pengcheng and others plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiachen, Gao Ge of Pengcheng and others plotted rebellion and were executed.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以右衞將軍顏師伯為青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, the General of the Right Guard Yan Shibo was made Inspector of Qing and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai General of the Right Guard Yan Shibo was made Inspector of Qing and Ji.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，河南王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day yiyou, the King of Henan sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiyou, the King of Henan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，中書令王僧達有罪，下獄死。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the Director of the Secretariat Wang Sengda, having committed a crime, was imprisoned and died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Director of the Secretariat Wang Sengda, having committed a crime, was imprisoned and died.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以強弩將軍杜叔文為寧州刺史，交州刺史費淹為廣州刺史，南海太守垣閬為交州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, the General of Powerful Crossbows Du Shuwen was made Inspector of Ning; the Inspector of Jiao Fei Yan was made Inspector of Guang; the Administrator of Nanhai Yuan Lang was made Inspector of Jiao.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou General of Powerful Crossbows Du Shuwen was made Inspector of Ning; Inspector of Jiao Fei Yan was made Inspector of Guang; Administrator of Nanhai Yuan Lang was made Inspector of Jiao.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以寧朔將軍沈僧榮為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the General Who Pacifies the North Shen Sengrong was made Inspector of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu General Who Pacifies the North Shen Sengrong was made Inspector of Yan.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，於華林園聽訟。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day guimao, cases were heard at the Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guimao, the emperor heard cases at the Hualin Garden.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以寧朔將軍劉道隆為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the General Who Pacifies the North Liu Daolong was made Inspector of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu General Who Pacifies the North Liu Daolong was made Inspector of Xu.

sentences.zh: 襄陽大水，遣使巡行賑贍。

translations.literal: Great floods struck Xiangyang; envoys were dispatched to tour the region and grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: Great floods struck Xiangyang; envoys were sent to tour the region and grant relief.

sentences.zh: 庚午，置武衞將軍、武騎常侍官。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, the posts of General of the Martial Guard and Regular Attendant of the Martial Cavalry were established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the posts of General of the Martial Guard and Regular Attendant of the Martial Cavalry were established.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲午，以中軍將軍義陽王昶為江州刺史。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jiawu, the General of the Central Army Prince of Yiyang Chang was made Inspector of Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiawu, General of the Central Army Prince of Yiyang Chang was made Inspector of Jiang.

sentences.zh: 乙未，高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, the state of Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，揚州刺史西陽王子尚加撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day renzi, Prince of Xiyang Zishang, Inspector of Yang, was given the additional title of General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renzi, Inspector of Yang Prince of Xiyang Zishang was given the additional title of General Who Pacifies the Army.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥，諸王及妃主庶姓位從公者，喪事聽設凶門，餘悉斷。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jihai, for princes and consorts of common surname holding ranks equal to the Three Excellencies, funeral rites might set up a mourning gate; all others were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jihai, princes and consorts of common surname holding ranks equal to the Three Excellencies might set up a mourning gate for funerals; all others were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚子，詔曰：「夫山處巖居，不以魚鼈為禮。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day gengzi, an edict was issued: Those who dwell in mountains and live in cliffs do not take fish and turtle as ritual offerings.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on gengzi, an edict declared: Those who dwell in mountains and live on cliffs do not take fish and turtle as ritual offerings.

sentences.zh: 頃歲多虞，軍調繁切，違方設賦，本濟一時，而主者玩習，遂為常典。

translations.literal: In recent years there has been much trouble; military levies have been urgent and pressing. Levies imposed contrary to local custom were meant to meet a moment's need, yet those in charge have grown accustomed to them and they have become regular practice.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years there has been much trouble; military levies have been urgent. Levies contrary to local custom were meant for a moment's need, yet officials have grown accustomed to them and they have become regular practice.

sentences.zh: 杶檊瑤琨，任土作貢，積羽羣輕，終致深弊。

translations.literal: Pawlonia, catalpa, jade, and fine stone—each land should offer what it produces; yet when feathers are piled, the weight grows light, and in the end deep harm is done.
translations.idiomatic: Pawlonia, catalpa, jade, and fine stone—each land should offer what it produces; yet when trifles accumulate, deep harm follows in the end.

sentences.zh: 永言弘革，無替朕心。

translations.literal: Ever speaking of broad reform, let it not fall short of my intent.
translations.idiomatic: Ever speaking of broad reform, let it not fall short of my intent.

sentences.zh: 凡寰衞貢職，山淵採捕，皆當詳辨產殖，考順歲時，勿使牽課虛懸，睽忤氣序。

translations.literal: All tribute duties of the capital region and products gathered from mountains and marshes must be examined in detail as to what each place produces and assessed according to the seasons, so that forced quotas hang empty in the air and run counter to the natural order.
translations.idiomatic: All tribute duties of the capital region and products gathered from mountains and marshes must be examined as to what each place produces and assessed by season, so that forced quotas are not imposed in vain and the natural order is not violated.

sentences.zh: 庶簡約之風，有孚於品性；

translations.literal: Thus may the wind of simplicity win trust in character;
translations.idiomatic: Thus may the wind of simplicity win trust in character;

sentences.zh: 惠敏之訓，無漏於幽仄。

translations.literal: and the teaching of grace and care leave none in remote corners neglected.」
translations.idiomatic: and the teaching of grace and care leave none in remote corners neglected.」

sentences.zh: 」庚申，上於華林園聽訟。

translations.literal: 」On the day gengshen, the emperor heard cases at the Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: 」On gengshen the emperor heard cases at the Hualin Garden.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，林邑國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the state of Linyi sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Linyi sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 是冬，索虜寇青州，刺史顏師伯頻大破之。

translations.literal: That winter the northern enemy raided Qing Province; the Inspector Yan Shibo repeatedly inflicted great defeats upon them.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the northern enemy raided Qing Province; Inspector Yan Shibo repeatedly inflicted great defeats on them.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丁亥，割豫州梁郡屬徐州。

translations.literal: In the third year, in the first month of spring, on the day dinghai, Liang commandery in Yu Province was detached and placed under Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on dinghai in the first month of spring, Liang commandery in Yu was detached and placed under Xu.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以驃騎將軍、領軍將軍柳元景為尚書令，尚書右僕射劉遵考為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, the General Who Pacifies the Cavalry and General of the Palace Garrison Liu Yuanjing was made Director of the Masters of Writing; the Right Vice Director Liu Zunkao was made General of the Palace Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou General Who Pacifies the Cavalry and General of the Palace Garrison Liu Yuanjing was made Director of the Masters of Writing, and Right Vice Director Liu Zunkao was made General of the Palace Garrison.

sentences.zh: 丙申，婆皇國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, the state of Bohuang sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Bohuang sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，以揚州所統六郡為王畿。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day yimao, the six commanderies governed by Yang Province were made the metropolitan domain.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yimao, the six commanderies governed by Yang were made the metropolitan domain.

sentences.zh: 以東揚州為揚州。

translations.literal: Eastern Yang Province was made Yang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Yang was made Yang Province.

sentences.zh: [16]時欲立司隸校尉，以元凶已立乃止。

translations.literal: Editorial note 16.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial note 16.

sentences.zh: 撫軍將軍、揚州刺史西陽王子尚徙為揚州刺史。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yang Prince of Xiyang Zishang was transferred to be Inspector of Yang.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yang Prince of Xiyang Zishang was made Inspector of Yang.

sentences.zh: 甲子，復置廷尉監官。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the post of Supervisor of the Court of Justice was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the post of Supervisor of the Court of Justice was restored.

sentences.zh: 荊州饑，三月甲申，原田租布各有差。

translations.literal: Jing Province suffered famine; in the third month, on the day jiashen, field rents and cloth taxes were remitted in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Jing suffered famine; in the third month, on jiashen, field rents and cloth taxes were remitted in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以義興太守垣閬為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, the Administrator of Yixing Yuan Lang was made Inspector of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Administrator of Yixing Yuan Lang was made Inspector of Yan.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，中護軍湘東王彧遷職，以中書令東海王褘為衞將軍、護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, the General Who Protects the Army Prince of Xiangdong Yu was transferred to another post; the Director of the Secretariat Prince of Donghai Hui was made General of the Guard and General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen General Who Protects the Army Prince of Xiangdong Yu was reassigned; Director of the Secretariat Prince of Donghai Hui was made General of the Guard and General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，太宰江夏王義恭加中書監。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, the Grand Preceptor Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was given the additional post of Supervisor of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Grand Preceptor Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was also made Supervisor of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸卯，上於華林園聽訟。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day guimao, the emperor heard cases at the Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guimao, the emperor heard cases at the Hualin Garden.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以建寧太守苻仲子為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, the Administrator of Jianning Fu Zhongzi was made Inspector of Ning.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Administrator of Jianning Fu Zhongzi was made Inspector of Ning.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，司空、南兗州刺史竟陵王誕有罪，貶爵。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, the Minister of Works and Inspector of Southern Yan Prince of Jingling Dan, having committed a crime, was degraded in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Minister of Works and Inspector of Southern Yan Prince of Jingling Dan, having committed a crime, was degraded in rank.

sentences.zh: 誕不受命，據廣陵城反，殺兗州刺史垣閬。

translations.literal: Dan refused the command, seized Guangling city in rebellion, and killed the Inspector of Yan Yuan Lang.
translations.idiomatic: Dan refused the command, seized Guangling in rebellion, and killed Inspector of Yan Yuan Lang.

sentences.zh: 以始興公沈慶之為車騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史討誕。

translations.literal: The Duke of Shixing Shen Qingzhi was made Grand General of the Agile Cavalry, with credentials equal to an open office with the Three Excellencies, and Inspector of Southern Yan to suppress Dan.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Shixing Shen Qingzhi was made Grand General of the Agile Cavalry, with credentials equal to an open office with the Three Excellencies, and Inspector of Southern Yan to suppress Dan.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上親御六師，車駕出頓宣武堂。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the emperor in person commanded the six armies; the imperial carriage moved out and halted at the Hall of Martial Proclamation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the emperor in person commanded the six armies; the imperial carriage moved out and halted at the Hall of Martial Proclamation.

sentences.zh: 司州刺史劉季之反叛，徐州刺史劉道隆討斬之。

translations.literal: The Inspector of Si Liu Jizhi rebelled; the Inspector of Xu Liu Daolong attacked and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Si Liu Jizhi rebelled; Inspector of Xu Liu Daolong attacked and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，剋廣陵城，斬誕。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jisi, Guangling city was taken and Dan was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jisi, Guangling was taken and Dan beheaded.

sentences.zh: 悉誅城內男丁，以女口為軍賞。

translations.literal: All males within the city were put to death; the women were taken as military reward.
translations.idiomatic: All males in the city were put to death; the women were taken as military reward.

sentences.zh: 是日解嚴。

translations.literal: That day the emergency regulations were lifted.
translations.idiomatic: That day the emergency regulations were lifted.

sentences.zh: 辛未，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 尚方長徒、奚官奴婢老疾者悉原放。

translations.literal: Long-term convicts of the Imperial Workshop and aged or sick palace women and eunuch slaves were all pardoned and released.
translations.idiomatic: Long-term convicts of the Imperial Workshop and aged or sick palace women and eunuch slaves were all pardoned and released.

sentences.zh: 孝子、順孫、義夫、節婦，賜粟帛各有差。

translations.literal: Filial sons, obedient grandsons, righteous husbands, and chaste wives were each granted grain and silk in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Filial sons, obedient grandsons, righteous husbands, and chaste wives each received grain and silk in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 王畿下貧之家，與近行頓所由，並蠲租一年。

translations.literal: Poor households within the metropolitan domain and those along the route of the recent imperial halt were all exempted from rent for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Poor households in the metropolitan domain and along the route of the recent imperial halt were all exempted from rent for one year.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以丹陽尹劉秀之為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, the Administrator of Danyang Liu Xiuzhi was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Administrator of Danyang Liu Xiuzhi was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，分淮南北復置二豫州。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, north and south of the Huai were again divided and two Yu Provinces were re-established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu north and south of the Huai were again divided and two Yu Provinces were re-established.

sentences.zh: 以新除車騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史沈慶之為司空，刺史如故。

translations.literal: The newly dismissed Grand General of the Agile Cavalry, with credentials equal to an open office with the Three Excellencies, and Inspector of Southern Yan Shen Qingzhi was made Minister of Works, his inspectorship remaining unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: The newly dismissed Grand General of the Agile Cavalry, with credentials equal to an open office with the Three Excellencies, and Inspector of Southern Yan Shen Qingzhi was made Minister of Works, retaining his inspectorship.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以衞將軍、護軍將軍東海王褘為南豫州刺史，衞將軍如故。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, the General of the Guard and General Who Protects the Army Prince of Donghai Hui was made Inspector of Southern Yu, his rank as General of the Guard remaining unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi General of the Guard and General Who Protects the Army Prince of Donghai Hui was made Inspector of Southern Yu, retaining his rank as General of the Guard.

translations.literal: The recent household registers adopted the new regulations; what the local offices have applied contains many gross errors. A general renewal of orders may be sent down, taking today as the beginning.
translations.idiomatic: The recent household registers adopted the new regulations; what local offices have applied contains many gross errors. Orders may be sent down everywhere, taking today as the beginning.

sentences.zh: 若先已犯制，亦同蕩然。

translations.literal: If one has already violated the regulations, the slate is likewise cleared.
translations.idiomatic: If one has already violated the regulations, the slate is likewise cleared.

sentences.zh: 」甲寅，加右光祿大夫羊玄保特進。

translations.literal: »On the day jiayin, the Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Yang Xuanbao was given the special advancement.
translations.idiomatic: »On jiayin Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Yang Xuanbao was given special advancement.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸巳，改封西陽王子尚為豫章王。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day guisi, the Prince of Xiyang Zishang was changed in enfeoffment to Prince of Yuzhang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guisi, Prince of Xiyang Zishang was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Yuzhang.

sentences.zh: 丙申，加尚書令柳元景左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, the Director of the Masters of Writing Liu Yuanjing was made Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and General with the Staff of Authority Equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Director of the Masters of Writing Liu Yuanjing was made Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and General with Staff Equal to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔曰：「南徐、兗二州去歲水潦傷年，民多困窶。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, an edict was issued: «Southern Xu and Yan provinces last year suffered flood and ruined the harvest; the people are much impoverished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu an edict declared: «Southern Xu and Yan provinces last year suffered floods that ruined the harvest; the people are much impoverished.

sentences.zh: 逋租未入者，可申至秋登。

translations.literal: Arrears of rent not yet paid in may be deferred until the autumn harvest is registered.»
translations.idiomatic: Arrears of rent not yet paid may be deferred until the autumn harvest is registered.»

sentences.zh: 」丙午，雍州刺史海陵王休茂殺司馬庾深之，舉兵反，義成太守薛繼考討斬之。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, the Inspector of Yong, Prince of Hailing Xiumao, killed his Chief Clerk Yu Shenzhi, raised troops in rebellion, and was pursued and beheaded by the Administrator of Yicheng Xue Jikao.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Inspector of Yong Prince of Hailing Xiumao killed his Chief Clerk Yu Shenzhi and rebelled; Administrator of Yicheng Xue Jikao pursued and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: [18]甲寅，以第九皇子子仁為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: [18] On the day jiayin, the ninth imperial son Ziren was made Inspector of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: [18] On jiayin the ninth imperial son Ziren was made Inspector of Yong.

sentences.zh: 五月癸亥，制帝室期親，朝官非祿官者，月給錢十萬。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day guihai, it was ordained that for the imperial clan within one remove in the mourning grades, court officials who were not salaried officials should receive one hundred thousand cash per month.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guihai, it was ordained that for the imperial clan within one remove in mourning grades, court officials who were not salaried officials should receive one hundred thousand cash per month.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，車駕幸閱武堂聽訟。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, the imperial carriage visited the Review of Arms Hall to hear cases.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the emperor visited the Review of Arms Hall to hear cases.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午，以護軍將軍義陽王昶為中軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day bingwu, the General Who Protects the Army, Prince of Yiyang Chang, was made General of the Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingwu, General Who Protects the Army Prince of Yiyang Chang was made General of the Central Army.

sentences.zh: 壬子，分廣陵置沛郡，省東平郡并廣陵。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Guangling was divided to establish Pei commandery; Eastern Ping commandery was abolished and merged into Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Guangling was divided to establish Pei commandery; Eastern Ping was abolished and merged into Guangling.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，詔曰：「雨水猥降，街衢泛溢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day bingchen, an edict was issued: «Rain has fallen in torrents and the streets overflow.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingchen, an edict declared: «Rain has fallen in torrents and the streets overflow.

sentences.zh: 可遣使巡行。

translations.literal: Envoys may be sent to tour and inspect.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys may be sent to tour and inspect.

sentences.zh: 窮弊之家，賜以薪粟。

translations.literal: Impoverished households shall be granted firewood and grain.»
translations.idiomatic: Impoverished households shall be granted firewood and grain.»

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the state of Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚午，曲赦雍州。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, a partial amnesty was proclaimed in Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu a partial amnesty was proclaimed in Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，立第九皇子子仁為永嘉王，第十一皇子子真為始安王。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day wuzi, the ninth imperial son Ziren was installed as Prince of Yongjia and the eleventh imperial son Zizhen as Prince of Shi'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuzi, the ninth imperial son Ziren was made Prince of Yongjia and the eleventh Zizhen Prince of Shi'an.

sentences.zh: 以北中郎參軍費伯弘為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: The Consulting Officer of the General of the North Zhonglang Fei Bohong was made Inspector of Ning.
translations.idiomatic: Consulting Officer of the General of the North Zhonglang Fei Bohong was made Inspector of Ning.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔曰：「自靈命初基，聖圖重遠。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, an edict was issued: «From the first foundation of the numinous mandate, the sacred design has been far-reaching.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou an edict declared: «From the first foundation of the numinous mandate, the sacred design has been far-reaching.

sentences.zh: 參正樂職，感神明之應；

translations.literal: Harmonizing and rectifying the duties of music, one answered to the response of spirits and gods;
translations.idiomatic: Harmonizing the duties of music, one answered to the response of spirits and gods;

sentences.zh: 崇殖禮囿，奮至德之光。

translations.literal: honoring and cultivating the garden of rites, one raised the radiance of utmost virtue.
translations.idiomatic: honoring and cultivating the garden of rites, one raised the radiance of utmost virtue.

sentences.zh: 聲實同和，文以均節，化調其俗，物性其情。

translations.literal: Fame and substance joined in harmony, pattern and text balanced the measure; custom was tuned and things kept their nature.
translations.idiomatic: Fame and substance joined in harmony, pattern and text balanced the measure; custom was tuned and things kept their nature.

sentences.zh: 故臨經式奠，煥乎炳發，道喪世屯，學落年永。

translations.literal: Thus when the classics were laid out for sacrifice, brilliance flamed forth; when the Way was lost and the age beset, learning fell and the years grew long.
translations.idiomatic: Thus when the classics were laid out for sacrifice, brilliance flamed forth; when the Way was lost and the age beset, learning fell and the years grew long.

sentences.zh: 獄訟微衰息之術，百姓忘退素之方。

translations.literal: Litigation had no art of gradual decline; the hundred surnames forgot the way of yielding and plainness.
translations.idiomatic: Litigation had no art of gradual decline; the common people forgot the way of yielding and plainness.

sentences.zh: 今息警夷嶂，恬波河渚，棧山航海，嚮風慕義，化民成俗，茲焉時矣。

translations.literal: Now alarms have ceased on the barbarian ridges and the river fords lie calm; scaling mountains and crossing seas, all turn to the wind and cherish righteousness— to transform the people and complete custom, this is the hour.
translations.idiomatic: Now alarms have ceased on the barbarian ridges and the river fords lie calm; scaling mountains and crossing seas, all turn to the wind and cherish righteousness—to transform the people and complete custom, this is the hour.

sentences.zh: [19]來歲可修葺庠序，旌延國冑。

translations.literal: [19] In the coming year the schools may be repaired and extended, and scions of the state enfeoffed.»
translations.idiomatic: [19] In the coming year the schools may be repaired and extended, and scions of the state enfeoffed.»

sentences.zh: 」庚寅，制方鎮所假白板郡縣，年限依臺除，食祿三分之一，不給送故。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, it was ordained that for the white-board commanderies and counties lent to frontier posts, the term of office should follow the capital's standard for removal; they should receive one-third of the salary and no send-off gift.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin it was ordained that for white-board commanderies and counties lent to frontier posts, the term of office should follow the capital's standard for removal; they should receive one-third of the salary and no send-off gift.

sentences.zh: 衞將軍東海王褘以本號開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: The General of the Guard, Prince of Donghai Hui, was given the additional title of General with the Staff of Authority Equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Guard Prince of Donghai Hui was also made General with Staff Equal to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the first day of the month, jiayin, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the first day jiayin, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，行幸琅邪郡，囚繫悉原遣。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the emperor traveled to Langye commandery; all prisoners confined were entirely pardoned and released.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the emperor traveled to Langye commandery; all prisoners were pardoned and released.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，移南豫州治淮南于湖縣。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, the seat of Southern Yu was moved to Huainan, at Yu county in Hu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the seat of Southern Yu was moved to Huainan, at Yu county in Hu.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以冠軍將軍尋陽王子房為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, the Champion General, Prince of Xunyang Zifang, was made Inspector of Southern Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Champion General Prince of Xunyang Zifang was made Inspector of Southern Yu.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊子，皇太子妃何氏薨。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day wuzi, the crown prince's consort, the Lady He, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on wuzi, the crown prince's consort Lady He died.

sentences.zh: 丙申，初立馳道，自閶闔門至于朱雀門，又自承明門至于玄武湖。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, the imperial racecourse was first established, from the Gate of Heaven to the Gate of the Vermilion Bird, and from the Gate of Bright Reception to the Black Tortoise Lake.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the imperial racecourse was first established, from the Gate of Heaven to the Gate of the Vermilion Bird, and from the Gate of Bright Reception to the Black Tortoise Lake.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，改封歷陽王子頊為臨海王。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, the Prince of Liyang Zixiang was changed in enfeoffment to Prince of Linhai.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Prince of Liyang Zixiang was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Linhai.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，以車騎將軍、南徐州刺史劉延孫為尚書左僕射、領護軍將軍，尚書右僕射劉秀之為安北將軍、雍州刺史。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jiayin, the General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Xu Liu Yansun was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and took charge as General Who Protects the Army; the Right Vice Director Liu Xiuzhi was made General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiayin, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Xu Liu Yansun was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and took charge as General Who Protects the Army; Right Vice Director Liu Xiuzhi was made General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Yong.

sentences.zh: 以冠軍將軍臨海王子頊為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: The Champion General, Prince of Linhai Zixiang, was made Inspector of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: Champion General Prince of Linhai Zixiang was made Inspector of Guang.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以東中郎將新安王子鸞為南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, the General of the East Zhonglang, Prince of Xin'an Ziluan, was made Inspector of Southern Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao General of the East Zhonglang Prince of Xin'an Ziluan was made Inspector of Southern Xu.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，詔曰：「王畿內奉京師，外表眾夏，民殷務廣，宜思簡惠。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day renchen, an edict was issued: «Within the royal domain one supplies the capital; without, one faces the myriad Xia. The people are numerous and affairs weighty—one should think of simplifying favors.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renchen, an edict declared: «Within the royal domain one supplies the capital; without, one faces the myriad Xia. The people are numerous and affairs weighty—one should think of simplifying favors.

sentences.zh: 可遣尚書就加詳檢，并與守宰平治庶獄。

translations.literal: The Masters of Writing may be sent to conduct a detailed inspection, and together with the guarding officials try the common people's cases.
translations.idiomatic: The Masters of Writing may be sent to conduct a detailed inspection, and together with the guarding officials try the common people's cases.

sentences.zh: 其有疑滯，具以狀聞。

translations.literal: Where there is doubt or delay, a full report shall be submitted.»
translations.idiomatic: Where there is doubt or delay, a full report shall be submitted.»

sentences.zh: 」丁酉，增置少府丞一人。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, one additional Assistant Director of the Palace Treasury was established.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou one additional Assistant Director of the Palace Treasury was established.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，以領軍將軍劉遵考為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day renshen, the General Who Protects the Army Liu Zunkao was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renshen, General Who Protects the Army Liu Zunkao was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，制天下民戶歲輸布四疋。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, it was ordained that households throughout the empire should pay four bolts of cloth per year.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu it was ordained that households throughout the empire should pay four bolts of cloth per year.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以太常王玄謨為平北將軍、徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, the Grand Minister of Ceremonies Wang Xuemo was made General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Grand Minister of Ceremonies Wang Xuemo was made General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Xu.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月己丑，湘州刺史建安王休仁加平南將軍。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, in the first month of spring, on the day jichou, the Inspector of Xiang, Prince of Jian'an Xiuren, was given the additional rank of General Who Pacifies the South.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on jichou in the first month of spring, Inspector of Xiang Prince of Jian'an Xiuren was given the additional rank of General Who Pacifies the South.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，車駕親祠南郊。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, the imperial carriage in person sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the emperor sacrificed at the Southern Suburb in person.

sentences.zh: 是日，又宗祀明堂。

translations.literal: On that day, the Bright Hall was also sacrificed to in the ancestral rite.
translations.idiomatic: On that day the Bright Hall was also sacrificed to in the ancestral rite.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 孝子、順孫、義夫、悌弟，賜爵一級，慈姑、節婦及孤老、六疾，賜帛五匹，穀十斛。

translations.literal: Filial sons, obedient grandsons, men of righteousness, and respectful younger brothers were each granted one rank of nobility; kindly mothers-in-law, chaste wives, and orphans, the aged, and the six kinds of affliction were each granted five bolts of silk and ten hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Filial sons, obedient grandsons, men of righteousness, and respectful younger brothers each received one rank of nobility; kindly mothers-in-law, chaste wives, orphans, the aged, and the six kinds of affliction each received five bolts of silk and ten hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 下四方旌賞茂異，其有懷真抱素，志行清白，恬退自守，不交當世，或識通古今，才經軍國，奉公廉直，高譽在民，具以名奏。

translations.literal: Banners of reward for outstanding merit were sent down throughout the realm; those who cherish truth and hold to simplicity, whose conduct is pure and whose will is clear, who retire in quiet and keep to themselves without mixing with the age, or who know past and present, whose talent spans state and army, who serve the public with integrity and straightness and enjoy high repute among the people—all are to be reported by name.
translations.idiomatic: Reward banners for outstanding merit were sent throughout the realm; those who cherish truth and plain integrity, whose conduct is pure, who live in quiet retirement without mixing with the world, or who know past and present and whose talent spans state and army, who serve the public with integrity and enjoy high repute among the people—all are to be reported by name.

sentences.zh: 乙未，置五官中郎將、左右中郎將官。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, the posts of Director of the Five Offices of the Palace Gentlemen and of the Left and Right Palace Gentlemen were established.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the posts of Director of the Five Offices of the Palace Gentlemen and of the Left and Right Palace Gentlemen were established.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，復百官祿。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day yimao, the salaries of all officials were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yimao, the salaries of all officials were restored.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，立第十三皇子子元為邵陵王。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day gengyin, the thirteenth imperial son Ziyuan was installed as Prince of Shaoling.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengyin, the thirteenth imperial son Ziyuan was made Prince of Shaoling.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以倭國王世子興為安東將軍。

translations.literal: On the day rentian, the crown prince of the state of Wa, Xing, was made General Who Pacifies the East.
translations.idiomatic: On rentian the crown prince of Wa, Xing, was made General Who Pacifies the East.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，改豫州南梁郡為淮南郡，舊淮南郡并宣城。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the Nanliang commandery of Yu Province was renamed Huainan commandery; the old Huainan commandery was merged into Xuancheng.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the Nanliang commandery of Yu was renamed Huainan; the old Huainan was merged into Xuancheng.

sentences.zh: 丁未，輔國將軍、征虜長史、廣陵太守沈懷文有罪，下獄死。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, the General Who Assists the State, Chief Clerk of the Campaign against the Barbarians, and Administrator of Guangling Shen Huaiwen, having committed a crime, was imprisoned and died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei General Who Assists the State, Chief Clerk of the Campaign against the Barbarians, and Administrator of Guangling Shen Huaiwen, having committed a crime, was imprisoned and died.

sentences.zh: 四月庚申，原除南兗州大明三年以前逋租。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on the day gengshen, arrears of rent owed before the third year of Daming in Southern Yan Province were entirely remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on gengshen, rent arrears owed before the third year of Daming in Southern Yan were entirely remitted.

sentences.zh: 新作大航門。

translations.literal: The Great Ferry Gate was newly built.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Ferry Gate was newly built.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，置凌室，修藏冰之禮。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day bingxu, the Cold Storehouse was established and the rite of storing ice was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingxu, the Cold Storehouse was established and the rite of storing ice was restored.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太宰江夏王義恭解領司徒。

translations.literal: On the day rentian, the Grand Preceptor Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was relieved of his concurrent post as Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On rentian Grand Preceptor Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was relieved of his concurrent post as Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，尚書左僕射、護軍將軍劉延孫卒。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day xinyou, the Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army Liu Yansun died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinyou, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army Liu Yansun died.

translations.literal: Editorial note 20.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial note 20.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚辰，以荊州刺史朱脩之為領軍將軍，廣州刺史臨海王子頊為荊州刺史。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day gengchen, the Inspector of Jing Zhu Xiuzhi was made General of the Palace Garrison; the Inspector of Guang, Prince of Linhai Zixiang, was made Inspector of Jing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengchen, Inspector of Jing Zhu Xiuzhi was made General of the Palace Garrison; Inspector of Guang Prince of Linhai Zixiang was made Inspector of Jing.

sentences.zh: 甲申，地震。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以輔國將軍王翼之為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, the General Who Assists the State Wang Yizhi was made Inspector of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi General Who Assists the State Wang Yizhi was made Inspector of Guang.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以西陽太守檀翼之為交州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, the Administrator of Xiyang Tan Yizhi was made Inspector of Jiao.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Administrator of Xiyang Tan Yizhi was made Inspector of Jiao.

sentences.zh: 乙未，立第十九皇子子雲為晉陵王。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, the nineteenth imperial son Ziyun was installed as Prince of Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the nineteenth imperial son Ziyun was made Prince of Jinling.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，原除雍州大明四年以前逋租。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day guihai, arrears of rent owed before the fourth year of Daming in Yong Province were entirely remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guihai, rent arrears owed before the fourth year of Daming in Yong were entirely remitted.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，置清臺令。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the post of Director of the Pure Terrace was established.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the post of Director of the Pure Terrace was established.

sentences.zh: 九月戊寅，制沙門致敬人主。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day wuyin, it was ordained that Buddhist monks should bow to the sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuyin, it was ordained that Buddhist monks should bow to the sovereign.

translations.idiomatic: Households in utmost distress shall have granaries opened for relief.
