translations.literal: »On the day yichou, the sixteenth imperial son Zimeng was installed as Prince of Huainan and the eighteenth imperial son Zichan as Prince of Linhe.
translations.idiomatic: »On yichou the sixteenth imperial son Zimeng was made Prince of Huainan and the eighteenth Zichan Prince of Linhe.

sentences.zh: 車駕幸建康秣陵縣訊獄囚。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage visited Jiankang's Moling county to hear the prisoners' cases.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor visited Jiankang's Moling county to hear the prisoners' cases.

sentences.zh: 九月巳卯，詔曰：「近炎精亢序，苗稼多傷。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jimao, an edict was issued: «Lately the fiery essence has run high in order and the grain shoots have suffered much harm.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jimao, an edict declared: «Lately the fiery essence has run high in order and the grain shoots have suffered much harm.

sentences.zh: 今二麥未晚，甘澤頻降，可下東境郡，勤課墾殖。

translations.literal: Though the second crop is not yet late, sweet rains have fallen in succession; the eastern-border commanderies may be ordered to urge cultivation and reclamation earnestly.
translations.idiomatic: Though the second crop is not yet late, sweet rains have fallen again and again; order the eastern-border commanderies to urge cultivation and reclamation.

sentences.zh: 尤弊之家，量貸麥種。

translations.literal: For households in greatest distress, wheat seed may be lent according to measure.
translations.idiomatic: For households in greatest distress, lend wheat seed according to measure.

sentences.zh: 」戊子，詔曰：「昔周王驥跡，實窮四溟；

translations.literal: »On the day wuzi, an edict was issued: «In olden days King Zhou's fleet left tracks that reached the four seas;
translations.idiomatic: »On wuzi an edict declared: «Of old King Zhou's fleet left tracks to the ends of the four seas;

sentences.zh: 漢帝鸞軫，夙遍五嶽。

translations.literal: Emperor Han's imperial carriage at dawn covered the five sacred peaks.
translations.idiomatic: the Han emperor's carriage at dawn traversed the five peaks.

sentences.zh: 皆所以上對幽靈，下理民土。

translations.literal: All were thereby to answer the shades above and govern the people's soil below.
translations.idiomatic: Both answered the shades above and ordered the people's soil below.

sentences.zh: 自天昌替馭，臨宮創圖，禮代夭鬱，世貿興毀。

translations.literal: Since Heaven's prosperity gave way to the chariot's passage and the palace first laid its plan, rituals perished in their prime and ages traded rise and ruin.
translations.idiomatic: Since Heaven's prosperity gave way and the palace first laid its design, ritual ages died young and generations traded rise and ruin.

sentences.zh: 皇家造宋，日月重光，琁璣得序，五星順命，而戎車歲動，陳詩義闕。

translations.literal: The imperial house founded Song; the sun and moon shone again, the jade pivots found their order, and the five stars obeyed their mandate—yet war-chariots moved year by year and the meaning of the Odes of Chen was lost.
translations.idiomatic: Our house founded Song: sun and moon shone anew, the celestial pivots fell into order, the five stars obeyed their mandate—yet war-chariots moved every year and the Odes of Chen lacked their lesson.

sentences.zh: 朕聿含五光，奄一天下，思盡寶戒之規，以塞謀危之路。

translations.literal: I now embrace the five radiances and hold the empire in one hand, thinking to exhaust the rules of treasured admonition and to block the road of plotted peril.
translations.idiomatic: I now embrace the five radiances and hold all beneath Heaven, seeking to exhaust every rule of treasured warning and to close the road of plotted peril.

sentences.zh: 當沿時省方，觀察風俗。

translations.literal: I shall follow the seasons and tour the regions, observing customs in their places.
translations.idiomatic: I shall tour the provinces in season and observe local custom.

sentences.zh: 外詳考舊典，以副側席之懷。

translations.literal: Let the outer offices examine the old canon in detail, to answer my restless side-seat longing.»
translations.idiomatic: Let the outer offices examine the old canon in detail, to answer my restless longing from the side seat.»

sentences.zh: 」庚寅，南徐州刺史新安王子鸞兼司徒。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, the Inspector of Southern Xu, Prince of Xin'an Ziluan, was additionally made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Inspector of Southern Xu Prince of Xin'an Ziluan was also made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 乙未，車駕幸廷尉訊獄囚。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, the imperial carriage visited the Court of Judicial Review to examine prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the emperor visited the Court of Judicial Review to examine prisoners.

sentences.zh: 丙申，立第十七皇子子嗣為東平王。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, the seventeenth imperial son Zisi was installed as Prince of Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the seventeenth imperial son Zisi was made Prince of Dongping.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅，太子冠，賜王公以下帛各有差。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day renyin, the crown prince received his capping; princes and dukes downward were each granted silk by grade.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on renyin, the crown prince received his capping; princes and dukes downward each received silk by grade.

sentences.zh: 戊申，車駕巡南豫州。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, the imperial carriage toured Southern Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the emperor toured Southern Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「朕巡幸所經，先見百年者，及孤寡老疾，並賜粟帛。

translations.literal: An edict was issued: «Where my tour passes, those I meet first who have lived a hundred years, along with widows, orphans, the aged, and the sick, shall all be granted grain and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: «Where my tour passes, those I meet first who have lived a hundred years, and widows, orphans, the aged, and the sick, shall all receive grain and cloth.

sentences.zh: 獄繫刑罪，並親聽訟。

translations.literal: Prisoners held for criminal punishment shall be heard in person at trial.
translations.idiomatic: Prisoners held on criminal charges shall be heard in person.

sentences.zh: 其士庶或怨鬱危滯，受抑吏司，或隱約潔立，負擯州里，皆聽進朕前，面自陳訴。

translations.literal: Should gentry and commoners harbor grievances stalled in peril, or be thwarted by office clerks, or dwell in obscurity with pure conduct yet be cast aside in their district—all may come before me and state their case face to face.
translations.idiomatic: If gentry or commoners harbor grievances stalled in peril, are thwarted by office clerks, or dwell in obscurity with pure conduct yet are cast aside in their district—all may come before me and plead face to face.

sentences.zh: 若忠信孝義，力田殖穀，一介之能，一藝之美，悉加旌賞。

translations.literal: If one shows loyalty, faith, filial piety, or righteousness, or tills fields and grows grain, or has ability though slight, or beauty of a single craft, each shall be commended and rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever shows loyalty, faith, filial piety, or righteousness, tills fields and grows grain, has even slight ability, or excels in a single craft—each shall be commended and rewarded.

sentences.zh: 雖秋澤頻降，而夏旱嬰弊。

translations.literal: Though autumn rains have fallen often, the summer drought still harms the distressed.
translations.idiomatic: Though autumn rains have fallen often, the summer drought still afflicts the distressed.

sentences.zh: 可即開行倉，[26]並加賑賜。

translations.literal: Relief granaries may be opened at once, [26] and additional relief grants bestowed.»
translations.idiomatic: Open the relief granaries at once, [26] and grant additional relief.»

sentences.zh: 」癸丑，行幸江寧縣訊獄囚。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, the tour went to Jiangning county to examine prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the emperor went to Jiangning county to examine prisoners.

sentences.zh: 車騎將軍、揚州刺史豫章王子尚加開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: The General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Yang, Prince of Yuzhang Zishang, was given the additional title of General with credentials equal to an open office with the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Yang Prince of Yuzhang Zishang was given credentials equal to an open office with the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，衞將軍、開府儀同三司東海王褘為司空，中軍將軍義陽王昶加開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, the General of the Guard and Prince of Donghai Hui, with open-office credentials, was made Minister of Works; the General of the Central Army, Prince of Yiyang Chang, was given additional credentials equal to an open office.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai General of the Guard Prince of Donghai Hui, with open-office credentials, was made Minister of Works; General of the Central Army Prince of Yiyang Chang was also given open-office credentials.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔曰：「賞慶刑威，奄國彝軌；

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, an edict was issued: «Reward and celebration, punishment and awe—these span the nation's constant norm;
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin an edict declared: «Reward and celebration, punishment and awe—these span the nation's constant norm;

sentences.zh: 黜幽升明，闢宇恒憲。

translations.literal: casting down the obscure and raising the bright opens the realm's enduring law.
translations.idiomatic: casting down the obscure and raising the bright opens the realm's enduring law.

sentences.zh: 故採言聆風，式觀侈質，貶爵加地，於是乎在。

translations.literal: Hence gathering words and heeding the wind, one thereby observes extravagance and substance; demotion of rank or addition of lands lies herein.
translations.idiomatic: Hence one gathers words and heeds the wind, thereby observing extravagance and substance; demotion of rank or addition of lands lies herein.

sentences.zh: 今類帝宜社，親巡江甸，因覲嶽守，躬求民瘼。

translations.literal: Now, at the ritual sacrifice to the earthly spirit, I personally tour the river region, thereby viewing the mountain lords and seeking the people's sores with my own body.
translations.idiomatic: Now, at the sacrifice to the earthly spirit, I personally tour the river region, view the mountain lords, and seek the people's sores myself.

sentences.zh: 思弘明試之典，以申考績之義。

translations.literal: I think to broaden the enlightened trial canon and to declare the meaning of performance assessment.
translations.idiomatic: I would broaden the enlightened trial canon and declare the meaning of performance assessment.

sentences.zh: 行幸所經，莅民之職，功宣於聽，即加甄賞。

translations.literal: Where my tour passes, for duties that govern the people—if merit is manifest upon inquiry, reward is granted at once.
translations.idiomatic: Where my tour passes, for duties that govern the people—if merit is manifest upon inquiry, reward follows at once.

sentences.zh: 若廢務亂民，隨諐議罰。

translations.literal: If one neglects office and harms the people, punishment follows the fault upon deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: If one neglects office and harms the people, punishment follows upon deliberation of the fault.

sentences.zh: 主者詳察以聞。

translations.literal: The responsible offices shall examine in detail and report.»
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices shall examine in detail and report.»

sentences.zh: 」己巳，車駕校獵於姑孰。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the imperial carriage held a hunting review at Guniang.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the emperor held a hunting review at Guniang.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，行幸歷陽。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day bingwu, the tour went to Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingwu, the emperor went to Liyang.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 南豫州別署勅繫長徒，一切原散。

translations.literal: Long-term convicts held under separate directives of Southern Yu were entirely pardoned and released.
translations.idiomatic: Long-term convicts held under separate directives of Southern Yu were entirely pardoned and released.

sentences.zh: 其兵期考襲讁戍，悉停。

translations.literal: Soldiers whose terms of service fell due for censure or frontier garrison were all halted.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers whose terms of service fell due for censure or frontier garrison were all halted.

sentences.zh: 歷陽郡女子百戶牛酒；

translations.literal: In Liyang commandery, one hundred households of women received oxen and wine;
translations.idiomatic: In Liyang commandery, one hundred households of women received oxen and wine;

sentences.zh: 高年孤疾，賜帛十匹，蠲郡租十年。

translations.literal: the elderly, orphans, and the sick were each granted ten bolts of silk, and the commandery's rent remitted for ten years.
translations.idiomatic: the elderly, orphans, and the sick each received ten bolts of silk, and the commandery's rent was remitted for ten years.

sentences.zh: 己未，太宰江夏王義恭加尚書令。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, the Grand Preceptor, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, was additionally made Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Grand Preceptor Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was also made Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 於博望梁山立雙闕。

translations.literal: At Bowang and Mount Liangshan twin gate-towers were erected.
translations.idiomatic: At Bowang and Mount Liangshan twin gate-towers were erected.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，車駕至自歷陽。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, the imperial carriage returned from Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the emperor returned from Liyang.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月甲戌，詔曰：「東境去歲不稔，宜廣商貨。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, in the first month of spring, on the day jiaxu, an edict was issued: «The eastern border did not ripen last year; commerce in grain should be expanded.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, on jiaxu in the first month of spring, an edict declared: «The eastern border did not ripen last year; commerce in grain should be expanded.

sentences.zh: 遠近販鬻米粟者，[29]可停道中雜稅。

translations.literal: Those who buy and sell rice and grain from near and far, [29] miscellaneous taxes along the road may be suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Those who buy and sell rice and grain from near and far, [29] may have miscellaneous road taxes suspended.

sentences.zh: 其以仗自防，悉勿禁。

translations.literal: Those who carry weapons for self-defense shall not be forbidden at all.»
translations.idiomatic: Those who carry weapons for self-defense shall not be forbidden.»

sentences.zh: 」癸未，安北將軍、雍州刺史劉秀之卒。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, the General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Yong Liu Xiuzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Yong Liu Xiuzhi died.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以平南將軍、湘州刺史建安王休仁為安南將軍、江州刺史，晉安王子勛為鎮軍將軍、雍州刺史，南徐州刺史新安王子鸞為撫軍將軍，[30]領司徒、刺史如故，輔國將軍江夏王世子伯禽為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, the General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Xiang, Prince of Jian'an Xiuren, was made General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiang; Prince of Jin'an Zixun was made General of the Martial Guard and Inspector of Yong; the Inspector of Southern Xu, Prince of Xin'an Ziluan, was made General Who Pacifies the Army, [30] retaining the posts of Minister of Works and inspector as before; the heir of the Prince of Jiangxia, heir-son Boqin, was made Inspector of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Xiang Prince of Jian'an Xiuren was made General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiang; Prince of Jin'an Zixun was made General of the Martial Guard and Inspector of Yong; Inspector of Southern Xu Prince of Xin'an Ziluan was made General Who Pacifies the Army, [30] retaining Minister of Works and his inspectorate; heir-son Boqin of Prince of Jiangxia was made Inspector of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，特進朱脩之卒。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day xinchou, the specially advanced Zhu Xiuzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinchou, specially advanced Zhu Xiuzhi died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔曰：「去歲東境偏旱，田畝失收。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, an edict was issued: «Last year the eastern border suffered partial drought, and fields lost their harvest.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin an edict declared: «Last year the eastern border suffered partial drought and fields lost their harvest.

sentences.zh: 使命來者，多至乏絕。

translations.literal: Envoys who came on mission often arrived utterly destitute.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys on mission often arrived utterly destitute.

sentences.zh: 或下窮流宂，頓伏街巷，朕甚閔之。

translations.literal: Some sank to the depths of wandering destitution and collapsed in the lanes and streets—my heart is much pained for them.
translations.idiomatic: Some sank into wandering destitution and collapsed in lanes and streets—I am deeply pained for them.

sentences.zh: 可出倉米付建康、秣陵二縣，隨宜贍恤。

translations.literal: Storehouse grain may be issued to Jiankang and Moling counties for relief as circumstances require.
translations.idiomatic: Issue storehouse grain to Jiankang and Moling counties for relief as circumstances require.

sentences.zh: 若濟拯不時，[31]以至捐棄者，嚴加糾劾。

translations.literal: If relief is not timely, [31] leading to abandonment and death, strict investigation and punishment shall follow.»
translations.idiomatic: If relief is not timely, [31] leading to abandonment and death, investigate and punish strictly.»

sentences.zh: 」乙巳，以鎮軍將軍湘東王彧為鎮北將軍、徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the General of the Martial Guard, Prince of Xiangdong, was made General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi General of the Martial Guard Prince of Xiangdong was made General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Xu.

sentences.zh: 平北將軍、徐州刺史王玄謨為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: The General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Xu Wang Xuanmo was made General of the Palace Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Xu Wang Xuanmo was made General of the Palace Garrison.

sentences.zh: 夏閏五月辛丑，以前御史中丞蕭惠開為青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fifth month of summer, on the day xinchou, the former Censor-in-Chief Xiao Hui Kai was made Inspector of Qing and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month of summer, on xinchou, former Censor-in-Chief Xiao Hui Kai was made Inspector of Qing and Ji.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太宰江夏王義恭領太尉。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, the Grand Preceptor, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, additionally took charge as Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Grand Preceptor Prince of Jiangxia Yigong additionally took charge as Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 特進、右光祿大夫羊玄保卒。

translations.literal: The specially advanced and Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Yang Xuanbao died.
translations.idiomatic: Specially advanced and Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Yang Xuanbao died.

sentences.zh: 庚申，帝崩於玉燭殿，時年三十五。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, the emperor died in the Jade Candle Hall, aged thirty-five.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the emperor died in the Jade Candle Hall, aged thirty-five.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙午，葬丹陽秣陵縣巖山景寧陵。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day bingwu, he was buried at the Jingning Mausoleum on Mount Yan in Moling county, Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingwu, he was buried at the Jingning Mausoleum on Mount Yan in Moling county, Danyang.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：役己以利天下，堯、舜之心也；

translations.literal: The historian writes: To toil oneself for the benefit of all under Heaven—that was the heart of Yao and Shun;
translations.idiomatic: The historian writes: To toil oneself for the benefit of all under Heaven—that was the heart of Yao and Shun;

sentences.zh: 利己以及萬物，中主之志也；

translations.literal: to benefit oneself and thereby reach the myriad things—that is the aim of a middling ruler;
translations.idiomatic: to benefit oneself and thereby reach the myriad things—that is the aim of a middling ruler;

sentences.zh: 盡民命以自養，桀、紂之行也。

translations.literal: to exhaust the people's lives to nourish oneself—that is the conduct of Jie and Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: to exhaust the people's lives to nourish oneself—that is the conduct of Jie and Zhou.

sentences.zh: 觀大明之世，其將盡民命乎！

translations.literal: Looking at the age of Daming, will it not exhaust the people's lives!
translations.idiomatic: Looking at the age of Daming, will it not exhaust the people's lives!

sentences.zh: 雖有周公之才之美，猶終之以亂，何益哉！

translations.literal: Though one had the talent and beauty of the Duke of Zhou, if one still ends in disorder, what good is it!
translations.idiomatic: Though one had the talent and beauty of the Duke of Zhou, if one still ends in disorder, what good is it!

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collator's Notes
translations.idiomatic: Collator's Notes

sentences.zh: 徙都督雍梁南北秦四州荊州之襄陽竟陵南陽順陽新野隨六郡諸軍事 「南陽」各本作「南陵」。

translations.literal: Transferred as regional inspector for all military affairs in Yong, Liang, Northern and Southern Qin, and the six commanderies of Xiangyang, Jingling, Nanyang, Shunyang, Xinye, and Sui in Jingzhou — In all editions "Nanyang" reads "Nanling".
translations.idiomatic: Transferred as regional inspector for all military affairs in Yong, Liang, Northern and Southern Qin, and the six Jingzhou commanderies of Xiangyang, Jingling, Nanyang, Shunyang, Xinye, and Sui — In all editions "Nanyang" reads "Nanling".

sentences.zh: 錢大昕廿二史考異云：「南陵當作南陽。

translations.literal: Qian Daxin's Examined Divergences in the Twenty-two Histories states: «Nanling should read Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Daxin's Examined Divergences in the Twenty-two Histories states: «Nanling should read Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 」按州郡志，荊州有南陽郡，無「南陵郡」。

translations.literal: »According to the Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies, Jingzhou had a Nanyang commandery and no "Nanling commandery".
translations.idiomatic: »According to the Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies, Jingzhou had a Nanyang commandery and no "Nanling commandery".

sentences.zh: 今從錢說改。

translations.literal: The text is emended here following Qian's view.
translations.idiomatic: The text is emended here following Qian's view.

sentences.zh: 丙子克定京邑 「丙子」各本及南史作「丙申」。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi the capital was secured — In all editions and the History of the Southern Dynasties "bingzi" reads "bingshen".
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the capital was secured — In all editions and the History of the Southern Dynasties "bingzi" reads "bingshen".

sentences.zh: 建康實錄作「丙子」。

translations.literal: The Jiankang Veritable Record reads "bingzi".
translations.idiomatic: The Jiankang Veritable Record reads "bingzi".

sentences.zh: 按是月癸酉朔，初二日甲戌，初三日乙亥，初四日丙子，二十四日丙申。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, that month began on guiyou; the second day was jiaxu, the third yihai, the fourth bingzi, and the twenty-fourth bingshen.
translations.idiomatic: According to the calendar, that month began on guiyou; the second day was jiaxu, the third yihai, the fourth bingzi, and the twenty-fourth bingshen.

sentences.zh: 據上文，初二日甲戌克京口城，初三日乙亥克東府，克定京師，當在初四日丙子。

translations.literal: According to the text above, on the second day, jiaxu, Jingkou city was taken; on the third, yihai, the Eastern Palace was taken; securing the capital should fall on the fourth day, bingzi.

translations.idiomatic: Wuxu — Sun Yan's Critical Essays states: «Judging from the xinyou and jisi before and after, wuxu must be corrupt.»

sentences.zh: 勤盡地利 「勤」各本並作「勸」，據元龜一九一改。

translations.literal: Likely the dynastic history mistakenly retained the entry from the daily records, and Shen Yue never went back to revise it, yet in the biography of Xiumao he sets out the full course of the affair.

translations.literal: Inspector of Southern Xu Prince of Xin'an Ziluan was made General Who Pacifies the Army: all editions omit the character "Southern"; supplemented according to the biography of Ziluan.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Southern Xu Prince of Xin'an Ziluan made General Who Pacifies the Army: all editions omit "Southern"; restored from Ziluan's biography.

sentences.zh: 若濟拯不時 「濟」各本並作「溫」，據元龜一九五改。

translations.literal: If relief and rescue are not timely: in all editions "relief" reads "warm"; corrected according to Yuance 195.
translations.idiomatic: If relief is not timely: in all editions "relief" reads "warm"; corrected per Yuance 195.
